title: W3C XML Schema anyURI
description: The anyURI datatype represents an Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) reference as defined in RFC 3987, either absolute or relative (§3.2.17)
$comment: The XSD anyURI lexical space is laxer than RFC 3986/3987: any XML character sequence is escapable into a URI, so only the XML Char production constrains it
